Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about solar energy and our services.

Most homeowners save 70-90% on their electricity bills. The exact savings depend on your energy consumption, roof size, and sunlight exposure. Our free consultation includes a detailed savings projection for your property.

Solar installation costs vary based on system size and requirements. For a typical residential installation (3-5 kW), costs range from ₹1.5-3 lakhs. However, with government subsidies and financing options, your net cost can be significantly lower. Most systems pay for themselves within 4-6 years.

Yes! Solar panels still generate electricity on cloudy days, though at reduced capacity (typically 10-25% of peak output). Modern panels are designed to work efficiently in various weather conditions. Any shortfall is automatically covered by grid power.

Quality solar panels last 25-30 years with minimal maintenance. We provide a 25-year performance warranty, guaranteeing at least 80% efficiency after 25 years. The inverter typically needs replacement after 10-15 years.

Yes! The Indian government offers substantial subsidies under the PM-KUSUM scheme. Residential installations can get up to 40% subsidy for systems up to 3 kW, and 20% for additional capacity up to 10 kW. We help you with all subsidy paperwork.

The entire process from initial consultation to activation typically takes 4-8 weeks. The actual installation work is completed within 2-3 days. Most of the time goes into permits, approvals, and grid connection formalities, which we handle for you.

Solar panels require minimal maintenance. We recommend cleaning panels 2-3 times a year to remove dust and debris. Our annual maintenance package includes professional cleaning, system inspection, and performance optimization for maximum output.

Absolutely! Through net metering, any excess power generated is fed back to the grid, and you receive credits on your electricity bill. This means your meter runs backwards when you generate more than you consume. We handle all net metering applications and approvals.
